endorsements.quote: Engaging with patients and patient advocacy communities to secure public trust and to put the development in the service and discretion of public

unlisted_practices: Validate the scientific approximations used in in silico models for their specific context of use.
Establish data and model standards to facilitate credibility of in silico trials and digital twins.
Ensure data accessibility for digital twins while maintaining privacy and security.
Ensure patient ownership of their digital twins.
Ensure individualized patient access to digital twin technology so all persons can equitably benefit.
Involve regulators throughout the development of in silico trial and digital twin technologies.
Harmonize efforts across regulators and academics to define good simulation practices.
Include the science and use of in silico trial and digital twin resources in graduate and continuing education.
Set up infrastructure for validation and integrate digital twins into general practice, including risk assessment and mitigation.
Establish a digital Contract Research Organization framework to systematize the development and execution of in silico trials.
Continue research funding for development of in silico trial and digital twin technologies.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/vision paper discussing the future and potential roadmap for in silico clinical trials and digital twins in healthcare.
